title: 隔條涌
subject: a Tai O sampan girl and the shrimp-paste maker on the far bank trading teasing lines across the creek all day, each refusing to be the first to cross, until they agree to meet halfway on the fifty-step bridge
caption: Tanka saltwater song, the Pearl River Delta boat-dwellers' improvised courting duet, in a sparse acoustic folk setting. A plucked qinqin carrying the tune with bright, slightly buzzy notes; a yehu coconut fiddle shadowing the vocal line half a beat behind; a wooden oar knocking a slow, loose pulse on the side of a boat; soft water lapping under everything. Very close and natural, like two people singing across a creek in the open air, voices forward, instruments small and dry, long breaths between lines. A man and a woman trading lines in open-throat folk voices, plain and unpolished, the melody following the speech tones, phrases ending with 'brother' and 'sister' tags, the chorus sung together. 76 BPM, G major pentatonic. Teasing and warm, a morning flirt across the water. No drum kit, no electric bass, no pop ballad strings, no reverb wash, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
大澳條涌 水退咗半截 囉
我喺棚屋門口 曬緊一地蝦醬
對面搖艇仔嗰個 妹呀
你今朝條辮 綁到咁高做乜

[Pre-Chorus]
哥呀 你啲蝦醬 臭晒成條涌
我條辮綁高 費事黐到你啲味

[Chorus]
隔條涌 隔條涌
你唔過嚟 我唔過去
橋就喺隔籬 得五十步
睇邊個 先頂唔順 囉

[Verse]
哥呀 你成日望過嚟 望足十轉
蝦醬未收 落雨你又唔理
人哋搭我條艇 問我笑乜
我話對面 有個傻佬 曬蝦醬 囉

[Pre-Chorus]
妹呀 我留咗一樽 最香嗰樽
你過嚟攞 我就唔收你錢

[Chorus]
隔條涌 隔條涌
你唔過嚟 我唔過去
橋就喺隔籬 得五十步
一樽蝦醬 等你過嚟攞 囉

[Bridge]
妹呀 夜晚收工 你過唔過嚟
哥呀 要過 你自己過
咁就一人行一半 喺橋中間等 囉

[Chorus]
隔條涌 隔條涌
你行廿五步 我行廿五步
五十步 行咗成個鐘
你隻手 仲有陣蝦醬味 囉

[Outro]
哥呀
聽朝記得 搭我條船
